dsh-width-tiers
Chat content-width tiers for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
English | 中文
## Tiers
| Tier | Content width | Sidebar |

| Standard 标准 | App default: `max(680px, min(column × 0.64, 920px))` | unchanged |
| Medium 中等 | 112

0px | unchanged |
| Wide 宽 | 1280px | unchanged |
| Ultra 超宽 | 1400px | unchanged |
| Full 全宽 | `max

(640px, column − 176px)` | collapsed to icon rail |
| Custom 自定义 | width recorded from a native drag

− 176px)` | collapsed to icon rail |
| Custom 自定义 | width recorded from a native drag | unchanged |

Fixed and custom widths are clamped by the app to
`max(640px, column − 176px)`; the standard tier fo

llows the app default
(680–920px). On a narrow window a wider fixed tier therefore behaves like
`ful

l`, and the menu shows the reachable maximum for fixed tiers (1280px
reads 640px on an 800px column)

`, and the menu shows the reachable maximum for fixed tiers (1280px
reads 640px on an 800px column).
## Features

- Uses the app's native width axis (`--dsh-chat-user-width` and
`dsh.conversation.contentWidth`), so

the built-in drag handles keep working.
- Persists the selected tier and restores it on the next vi

sit.
- Follows **Settings → Language** (中文 / English / 日本語 / Español / Français / Deutsch / Русский

/ Português), including the Settings plugin card's title and summary (`locale/<lang>.json`).
- Menu

supports ArrowUp/Down, Home/End, Escape and Tab, with focus restoration.
- Tier changes sync across

tabs.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Never touches the right panel. Only `full` collapses th

e left sidebar, and
you can expand it again at any time.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the page. A six-bar picker appears at the
bottom-right.
For a local checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Usage

- Click the picker and choose a tier.
- Picking `Custom` before the first drag opens a guide at the

right edge; drag
a native handle to record a width.
- Dragging any native handle switches to `Custom

`; the plugin steps aside while
you drag.
- `Standard` clears the width preference and returns to th

e app default.
- `Full` collapses the left sidebar; the icon rail stays available.
## How it works

- Mounts the picker into the frame-wide `shell.overlay` slot; the plugin fiber
owns the controller l

ifetime, so no listeners or timers outlive it.
- The controller publishes an immutable snapshot (tie

r, menu, guide); the React
picker renders it and dispatches actions, so the view can remount without

rebuilding observers.
- Locates the conversation body that declares `--dsh-chat-content-width`
(pre

fers `[data-conversation-content]`, skips the right sidebar's embedded
conversation), then writes `-

-dsh-chat-user-width` on its parent.
- Stores the configured target in the app preference; only the

inline width is
clamped to `max(640px, column − 176px)`.
- Watches the column with `ResizeObserver`

so `full` follows sidebar, rightbar
and window changes.
- Drives panels through `ctx.layout` and reg
isters copy through `ctx.locale`.
## Compatibility

- DSH Web 0.2.x with a `web` profile (`shell.overlay` slot and `slots` service).
- Width axis checke

d against DSH 0.2.2-alpha.3: 640px floor, 176px handle
budget, `--dsh-chat-*` variables, `data-width

-handle`, layout/locale services.
- Narrow screens: the picker hides while alpha.3's sidebar drawer
(`data-sidebar-drawer`) is open and follows the on-screen keyboard.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The sources live in `src/` (`src/index.ts` is the no-op host entry, the
feature lives in `src/client

/`); `lib/` is the built, published payload. The
vitest suites import the sources directly: the cont

roller runs under jsdom and
the picker is rendered with Testing Library, so no live DSH instance is

required. `verify:client` checks the built bundle contract. Development needs
Node 22+ and pnpm.
## Notes

- Wider fixed tiers are clamped on narrow windows.
- A custom width dragged on a narrow window is cl

amped by the app before it is
recorded.
